title: Worlds Within Words: Translating Culture in Ancient Chinese Texts with Multi-Agent Coordination

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating translation systems on 'culture-loaded words' (CLWs) to measure their ability to preserve cultural connotations and provide necessary explicitation rather than defaulting to literal translations that ignore culturally grounded concepts.

The paper identifies and mitigates cognitive biases in LLM-as-a-Judge frameworks, specifically measuring and correcting for 'halo bias' (where fluency masks technical errors), 'length bias' (unfairly rewarding longer translations), and 'scale mismatch' (inconsistent scoring criteria across different samples).
